from pathlib import Path


DISPATCHER = (
    Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
    / 'tools'
    / 'mirror_sync'
    / 'universal_job_dispatcher.py'
)


def test_pytest_check_injects_worktree_backend_pythonpath():
    text = DISPATCHER.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    assert 'backend_path = str(worktree / \"backend\")' in text
    assert '\"PYTHONPATH\": backend_path' in text
    assert 'env_extra=env_extra' in text
    assert 'PYTHON_BIN, \"-m\", \"pytest\"' in text
